# Report — iteration 2

Delta against iteration 1. GOAL slices **(c)** and **(d)** are now built:
canonical agents, per-harness renderers, `POST /api/registry/install`, and
the install-matrix page. Four commits, one per slice; 164 tests green
(was 89); `prompts/generate.py --check` clean.

## What was done

**1. `slice(canonical-agent-model)` — ff992f8**
- `registry/agents.py` (new, 348 lines): the canonical agent entity
  `{name, description, instructions, model_tier, tool_policy}` stored as
  `registry/canonical-agents/<name>.md` (YAML frontmatter + Markdown body =
  the instructions), with `MODEL_TIERS` (standard|high|cheap -> per-harness
  model fields) and `TOOL_POLICIES` (read-only|edit|spawn -> per-harness
  permission fields) as explicit tables, plus one renderer per harness.
  Serialization goes entirely through iteration 1's frozen `api:ScanAPI`
  (`join_file` / `dump_frontmatter` / `dump_toml`) — no second format writer.
  `HARNESS_SUPPORT` marks omnigent unsupported with a human-readable reason;
  `render_agent` raises `UnsupportedHarness` rather than emitting a broken
  file. `agent_index_records()` computes each render's `body_hash` with
  `entry_record`'s exact rule so an installed file is directly comparable.
- `registry/canonical-agents/registry-scout.md` (cheap/read-only) and
  `registry-editor.md` (standard/edit): two real seeds with genuine
  instruction bodies. Deliberately not `trio-*` — that namespace is
  generate.py's.
- `registry/tests/test_agents.py`: 31 tests (round-trip, validation, every
  renderer against the real parser, all 9 tier x policy combinations, CRUD in
  a tempdir, and the render<->`entry_record` hash invariant per harness).

**2. `slice(index-agents)` — 7e65ec7**
- `registry/scan.py`: `build_index` now groups `surface == "agent"` as well
  as skill/command, and takes an optional `canonical_agents` list to emit a
  new always-present `agent_matrix` key (one row per canonical agent, one
  cell per harness, status `in-sync|stale|missing|unsupported`).
- `generated_paths()`: loads `prompts/generate.py` and asks its own
  `all_outputs()` which files it owns (48), memoized and best-effort;
  `entry_record` marks those `managed`. This is what makes the dashboard
  able to show generator-owned files read-only.
- `registry/tests/test_scan.py`: +270 lines, including a hash-stability
  guard proving the `managed` change moved no hash.

**3. `slice(agent-install-api)` — f46df27**
- `dashboard/serve.py`: `load_agents_module()` (twin of
  `load_registry_module()`, own assertion list); `_registry_index` feeds
  `agent_index_records()` into `build_index`, so `GET /api/registry` carries
  `agent_matrix` (degrading to `[]`, not a 500, if a canonical agent file is
  broken); canonical-agent CRUD under `/api/registry/agents...`; and
  `POST /api/registry/install {agent, harness}` rendering into the harness
  global dir via the existing format-aware `_registry_target`, answering
  201 created / 200 updated, and refusing omnigent or any unknown harness
  with a structured 400 carrying `reason`.
- `_reject_if_managed()` guards all four write paths (PUT, create, import,
  DELETE) with a 403 naming `prompts/generate.py`.
- `registry/tests/test_serve_agents.py`: 19 HTTP-level tests, install
  exercised against a monkeypatched temp harness dir.

**4. `slice(matrix-page)` — e90104b**
- `dashboard/agents.html` + `agents.js` (new page at `/agents.html`): matrix
  of agents x harnesses with Install/Update buttons, an inline canonical-agent
  editor, a "Generator-managed (read only)" section, `nav.js` workspace
  wiring, plain ES, no innerHTML, skills.html's class vocabulary reused.
- `.status-missing` added to `dashboard/app.css`; reciprocal Agents links in

- `registry/tests/test_serve_pages.py`: 8 tests (new routes, the CSS rule,
  reciprocal links, no-innerHTML convention, and a 200 regression guard on
  every pre-existing static route).

## Deviations from plan

- The planned `GET /api/registry/matrix` endpoint was dropped: wiring
  `agent_index_records()` into `_registry_index` means `GET /api/registry`
  already carries `agent_matrix`, so a second endpoint would have been a
  second cache to keep coherent. PLAN's `api:InstallAPI` was updated to
  match before the slice was delegated.
- Acceptance B9 asked for `.status-missing` in `app.css`; that is where it

- Throwaway canonical-agent test names use the prefix `z_trio_agent_test_`
  rather than `__trio_agent_test__`: the frozen validator's
